links.effect: >99.9% format adherence with constrained decoding vs 87.4% with unconstrained prompting
links.quote: Constrained decoding achieved >99.9% format adherence, far surpassing unconstrained prompting (87.4%).

links.comparator_used: General-purpose Llama models (Llama-3.3-70B and Llama-3.1-8B); the medically fine-tuned OpenBioLLM-70B and reasoning-model DeepSeek-R1-8B were the domain-specific variants
links.outcome: Accuracy across 70 information extraction tasks on the calibration set
links.effect: Llama-3.3-70B exceeded 90% accuracy on 59/70 tasks and outperformed OpenBioLLM-70B (medically fine-tuned) and DeepSeek-R1-8B; per-model figures not given in the abstract
links.quote: Llama-3.3-70B performed best, exceeding 90% accuracy on 59/70 tasks, outperforming Llama-3.1-8B (a smaller variant), OpenBioLLM-70B (a medically fine-tuned model), and DeepSeek-R1-8B.
